title: ledger/{url_hash16}.json (v3.0)
description: One per distinct URL ever seen for an institution, across scrape years. Per IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §6 and DATABASE_SCHEMA.md's Ledger table. Updated in place on a re-seen URL (last_seen_date/fingerprint_content_hash change; first_seen_date is fixed at creation) -- the one archive file exempt from invariant 1's append-only rule, since it's dedup bookkeeping, not archived content.

fingerprint_content_hash.description: sha256 of the fetched content after stripping boilerplate/date tokens (full dates, ranges, bare years, phrases like 'this reporting period') -- distinct from manifest.json's sha256, which hashes the raw stored bytes.
